mapper.insert: INSERT INTO word(user_id, word, chinese, count) VALUES(#{userId}, #{word}, #{chinese}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE count = count + 1, chinese = VALUES(chinese)
mapper.select:
SELECT id, user_id, word, chinese, count, dict_correct, dict_total, created_at FROM word WHERE
ORDER BY COALESCE(dict_correct * 1.0 / NULLIF(dict_total, 0), 1) ASC, count DESC, id DESC
ORDER BY count DESC, id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM word WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND word = #{word}
